title: Moroccan Darija Jokes Dataset Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for authentic Moroccan Darija jokes dataset

id.description: Unique identifier for the Moroccan Darija joke

darija_text.description: Authentic Moroccan Darija joke text in Arabic script

transliteration.description: Phonetic transliteration in Latin script (Arabizi/Darija romanization)

category.description: Thematic category (e.g. daily_life, school, medical, transport, witty, cafe, workplace)
